title: 第96章:斩咒破祭，龙脉归宁

山巅之上，煞气倾覆，雷光漫天。

三道漆黑龙形煞气咆哮俯冲，龙爪撕裂空气，带着毁灭般的压迫感，直扑小队阵型。龙身缠绕怨魂黑雾，所过之处，空气冻结、土石风化，邪力霸道至极。

“石障封龙！”

李安琪眸光凝金，双手猛然向外一拍，山巅无数黑石浮空堆砌，三层厚重石墙层层叠叠，横亘众人前方。石墙表面流转纯净土系灵光，死死抵住第一道龙煞冲击。

轰隆——

龙煞撞在石墙之上，气浪狂暴翻滚，碎石漫天炸裂，第一层石墙瞬间崩碎，第二层、第三层接连震颤。

杨瑞同时催动全身法器，八枚法牌结成连环结界，金光笼罩全队，结界之上刻满镇煞符文，硬生生扛下剩余两道龙煞的碾压冲击。

爆炸声接连不断，狂风卷着碎石肆虐山巅，整片祭坛剧烈晃动。

半空之中，范梦雪孤身牵制鬼将。

漫天雷丝缠绕鬼将庞大身躯，银白雷光不断灼烧煞气本体，鬼将痛苦嘶吼，粗大锁链疯狂震颤，黑色煞气不断消融。可它终究是百年煞气凝练的鬼妖，肉身坚硬无比，纵然被雷火灼烧，依旧悍不畏死，挥舞漆黑鬼爪，一次次拍碎雷网，朝着范梦雪猛扑。

范梦雪身法灵动，在半空辗转腾挪，雷尺不断劈出凝练雷刃，每一刀都精准斩在鬼将煞气薄弱之处，硬生生把鬼将死死困在高空，无法下压干扰地面战局。

两侧石阶，唐门姐妹已然逼近两名侧位大咒师。

两名咒师察觉到威胁，抬手召出黑雾结界，周身咒纹流转，想要隔绝暗器偷袭。可王欣欣、茉沫身法诡异，借石障掩护，贴地滑行，转瞬绕至结界死角。

“封脉！”

两道银针破空，精准穿透黑雾缝隙，刺入两名咒师肩颈哑穴与灵气经脉。

滋啦一声，破煞毒针封住咒力流转，两名大咒师口中咒诵骤然卡顿，气息紊乱，三角锁龙阵的平衡瞬间裂开破绽。

正中主咒师瞳孔骤缩，怒喝一声，想要补全咒印、稳固阵纹。

可已经晚了。

胡九郎已然冲上主坛石阶，黑衣猎猎，周身八卦金光流转，无视漫天血纹怨气，径直踏碎层层煞气，出现在主咒师身前。

“你中土道门，屡次坏我大事，当真该死！”主咒师面目狰狞，舍弃咒文，手持镇魂木杖，狠狠砸向胡九郎头顶。

Chapter 96: Cutting off the curse and breaking the sacrifice, the dragon's veins return to peace - "749 Game of the Taoist Priest Descending the Mountain"

On the top of the mountain, the evil spirit overturned and thunder filled the sky.

Three jet-black dragon-shaped evil spirits roared and swooped down, the dragon claws tore through the air, and with a sense of destructive oppression, they headed straight towards the team's formation.The dragon's body is wrapped in the black mist of resentful souls. Wherever it passes, the air freezes, the earth and rocks are weathered, and the evil force is extremely overbearing.

"Stone barrier seals the dragon!"

Li Anqi's eyes were golden, and she suddenly clapped her hands outward. Countless black stones were piled up in the air on the top of the mountain, and three layers of thick stone walls were stacked on top of each other, stretching in front of everyone.Pure earth spiritual light circulated on the surface of the stone wall, resisting the first dragon attack.

Boom——

The dragon evil hit the stone wall, the air waves rolled violently, and the rubble exploded all over the sky. The first layer of stone wall instantly shattered, and the second and third layers trembled one after another.

Yang Rui activated his magic weapons at the same time, and eight magic cards formed a chain barrier. Golden light enveloped the entire team. The barrier was engraved with evil-suppressing runes, and he could withstand the crushing impact of the remaining two dragon evils.

Explosions continued one after another, strong winds swept the rubble across the mountain top, and the entire altar shook violently.

In mid-air, Fan Mengxue restrained the ghost general alone.

Thunder threads all over the sky wrapped around the ghost general's huge body, and the silver-white thunder continued to burn the body of the evil spirit. The ghost general roared in pain, the thick chains trembled crazily, and the black evil spirit continued to melt.But after all, it is a ghost demon that has been condensed for hundreds of years. Its body is extremely hard. Even if it is burned by thunder and fire, it is still fearless of death. It waves its dark ghost claws, smashes the thunder net again and again, and pounces towards Fan Mengxue.

Fan Mengxue's movements were agile, tossing and turning in mid-air, and the thunder ruler kept striking out condensed thunder blades. Each strike struck precisely at the weak point of the ghost general's evil aura, forcibly trapping the ghost general high in the air, unable to press down to interfere with the battle on the ground.

On the stone steps on both sides, the Tang Clan sisters were already approaching two great spell masters.

The two spell masters sensed the threat and raised their hands to summon a black mist barrier. The spell patterns flowed around their bodies, trying to block the sneak attacks from hidden weapons.But Wang Xinxin and Mo Mo's movements were weird. They took advantage of the stone barrier to slide close to the ground and reached the dead end of the barrier in an instant.

"Seal the pulse!"

Two silver needles shot through the air, accurately penetrated the gaps in the black mist, and penetrated the dumb points on the shoulders and necks of the two spell masters and the spiritual energy meridians.

With a sizzling sound, the Evil-Breaking Poison Needle sealed the flow of spell power. The two great spell masters suddenly paused in their chanting, their breaths were disordered, and the balance of the triangle-locking dragon formation instantly cracked.

The main spell master's pupils shrank suddenly and he shouted angrily, trying to complete the spell seal and stabilize the formation.

But it's too late.

Hu Jiulang had already rushed up the stone steps of the main altar, dressed in black, with golden light flowing around his body. He ignored the blood-stained resentment in the sky, crushed the layers of evil energy, and appeared in front of the main spell master.

"You from the Middle Earth Dao Sect have ruined my affairs many times, so you deserve to die!" The main spell master looked ferocious, abandoned the incantation, held the soul-suppressing wooden staff, and hit Hu Jiulang's head hard.
